en: Black‑and‑white elevated view of a small European town with tree‑lined main street running from the foreground toward the horizon. In the foreground are brick and half‑timbered houses; in the mid‑ground stand larger villas and civic buildings with ornate roofs and dormers. In the distance are factory chimneys and, on a hill, a large castle‑like palace or manor with towers. The architecture strongly suggests Central Europe in the early 20th century. One building in the middle left bears a painted sign with German text.
